text.text: Released in 2004, V.Smile was an educational console developed by VTech for young children. The system combined video games with learning activities and used cartridge-based software featuring popular characters from Disney, Nickelodeon, and other children's franchises. Its controller was designed with large buttons and educational controls for early learners. V.Smile became one of the most successful educational gaming systems, continuing VTech's focus on interactive learning products.
